## IGramstaxBuildOptions type

Parsed `gramstax build` flags.

**Signature:**

```typescript
type IGramstaxBuildOptions = {
    dryRun?: boolean;
    raw?: boolean;
    target?: string;
    bundle?: boolean;
};
```

## Remarks

Produced by `GramstaxBuild._parseArgv` from `--dry-run`<!-- -->, `--raw`<!-- -->, `--target <name>`<!-- -->, and `--bundle`<!-- -->. All fields optional — an empty object means plain `gramstax build` with defaults.
